facts.fact: 他从 Jess 的单身派对回到事务所，三双眼睛盯着他看，直到其中一双眼睛的主人「故意」清了清嗓子他才发觉
facts.anchor: the three pairs of eyes staring at me until the owner of one of them pointedly clears their throat

facts.fact: 三个观察者里第三个清了清嗓子开口，话说到破折号就断了，问题始终没问完
facts.anchor: The third observer clears his throat. “We were just wondering what—”

facts.fact: 他告诉 Lucy 自己为什么会在那家酒吧，Lucy 脸上的背叛神情让他已经够难受了
facts.anchor: The betrayal on Lucy’s face when I told her why I was at the bar was terrible enough.

facts.fact: 同事们盯的其实不是他，而是他头顶正上方的那个空间
facts.anchor: they’re not staring at me, exactly—but at the space just above my head

facts.fact: 开口问「那是什么」的那位同事，比 Daniel 早几十年加入事务所
facts.anchor: someone who joined the Agency a few decades before I did

facts.fact: 他大声呻吟着，把派对上戴的那顶 dildo tiara 从头上扯了下来
facts.anchor: With a loud groan I tear the dildo tiara monstrosity off my head.

facts.fact: 他威胁三个同事：否则就告诉高管，去年在 CEO 画像上画小胡子的是他们
facts.anchor: Or I will tell the Executives that you were the ones who drew mustaches on all the CEO’s portraits last year.

facts.fact: 结尾他心里盘算：也许——只是也许——该告诉 Lucy 自己到底是谁
facts.anchor: tell her the truth about who I really am
